title: Qufeng xuanbi formula attenuates HDM-induced allergic asthma by targeting the STING/HIF-1alpha/glycolysis axis.
authors: Ye, Wufei; Wang, Bohan; Ye, Jingrui; Qiao, Zhou; Guan, Qihan; Ruan, Yang; Xu, Yanqiu; Zhang, Chaofeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过STING/HIF-1alpha/糖酵解轴缓解过敏性哮喘，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心为疾病药理机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Qufeng Xuanbi Formula (QFXBF), a traditional Chinese medicine prescription used for asthma-like respiratory disorders, has shown anti-asthmatic activity. However, whether it attenuates allergic airway remodeling through innate immune-metabolic regulation remains unknown. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to determine whether QFXBF alleviates house dust mite (HDM)-induced allergic airway inflammation and remodeling through targeting the STING/HIF-1alpha/glycolysis axis, and to evaluate the specific inhibitory potential of its constituent tectorigenin on STING-mediated immunometabolic signaling. MATERIALS AND METHODS: An HDM-induced allergic asthma model was established in male C57BL/6 mice by intranasal sensitization and challenge, followed by oral administration of QFXBF at 12.5, 25, and 50 g/kg/day or dexamethasone at 2 mg/kg/day. Airway hyperresponsiveness, lung histopathology, mucus secretion, collagen deposition, alpha-SMA expression, inflammatory mediators in BALF and serum, and glycolytic metabolic indices were evaluated. BSMCs were stimulated with IL-4 and LPS, both at 5 ng/mL, and treated with QFXBF at 2, 4, and 8 mg/mL. Cell proliferation, migration, glucose consumption, lactate production, RT-qPCR, Western blotting, and immunofluorescence were performed to assess airway smooth muscle activation and metabolic reprogramming. Transcriptomic analysis of lung tissue, STING overexpression, HIF-1alpha pharmacological inhibition, LC-MS/MS-based identification of tectorigenin, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations were further used to investigate the STING/HIF-1alpha/glycolysis axis and the potential STING-targeting activity of tectorigenin. RESULTS: QFXBF markedly reduced airway hyperresponsiveness, inflammatory infiltration, and collagen deposition in HDM-challenged mice, accompanied by decreased asthma-related markers in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid and serum. QFXBF also downregulated STING, HIF-1alpha, and key glycolytic enzymes at both mRNA and protein levels in lung tissue. In IL-4+LPS-stimulated BSMCs, QFXBF dose-dependently suppressed proliferation and migration, reduced glucose utilization and lactate accumulation, and concurrently inhibited STING/HIF-1alpha and glycolysis-associated factors. Mechanistically, QFXBF attenuated HIF-1alpha activity and glycolytic flux through suppression of STING. Liquid chromatography-based analysis identified tectorigenin as a bioavailable constituent of QFXBF. In STING-overexpressing BSMCs, tectorigenin significantly reduced STING expression, proliferative activity, and lactate metabolism, supporting STING inhibition as a key pharmacological basis of QFXBF. CONCLUSION: QFXBF can alleviate allergic remodeling by suppressing the STING/HIF-1alpha-mediated glycolytic program. Tectorigenin may act as a potential STING inhibitor that disrupts innate immune-metabolic signaling, providing mechanistic support for QFXBF-derived therapeutic strategies in asthma.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：祛风宣痹方（QFXBF）是一种用于哮喘样呼吸系统疾病的传统中药方剂，已显示出抗哮喘活性。然而，其是否通过先天免疫-代谢调节减轻过敏性气道重塑仍不清楚。研究目的：本研究旨在确定QFXBF是否通过靶向STING/HIF-1alpha/糖酵解轴减轻屋尘螨（HDM）诱导的过敏性气道炎症和重塑，并评估其成分鸢尾苷元对STING介导的免疫代谢信号的特异性抑制潜力。材料与方法：通过鼻内致敏和激发建立雄性C57BL/6小鼠HDM诱导的过敏性哮喘模型，随后以12.5、25和50 g/kg/天口服QFXBF或2 mg/kg/天地塞米松。评估气道高反应性、肺组织病理学、黏液分泌、胶原沉积、α-SMA表达、BALF和血清中的炎症介质以及糖酵解代谢指标。BSMCs用IL-4和LPS（均为5 ng/mL）刺激，并以2、4和8 mg/mL的QFXBF处理。进行细胞增殖、迁移、葡萄糖消耗、乳酸产生、RT-qPCR、Western blotting和免疫荧光检测，以评估气道平滑肌激活和代谢重编程。进一步采用肺组织转录组分析、STING过表达、HIF-1alpha药理学抑制、基于LC-MS/MS的鸢尾苷元鉴定、分子对接和分子动力学模拟，以研究STING/HIF-1alpha/糖酵解轴及鸢尾苷元潜在的STING靶向活性。结果：QFXBF显著降低HDM激发小鼠的气道高反应性、炎症浸润和胶原沉积，同时降低支气管肺泡灌洗液和血清中哮喘相关标志物。QFXBF还在mRNA和蛋白水平下调肺组织中STING、HIF-1alpha和关键糖酵解酶。在IL-4+LPS刺激的BSMCs中，QFXBF剂量依赖性地抑制增殖和迁移，减少葡萄糖利用和乳酸积累，并同时抑制STING/HIF-1alpha和糖酵解相关因子。机制上，QFXBF通过抑制STING减弱HIF-1alpha活性和糖酵解通量。基于液相色谱的分析鉴定鸢尾苷元为QFXBF的可生物利用成分。在STING过表达的BSMCs中，鸢尾苷元显著降低STING表达、增殖活性和乳酸代谢，支持STING抑制作为QFXBF的关键药理学基础。结论：QFXBF可通过抑制STING/HIF-1alpha介导的糖酵解程序减轻过敏性重塑。鸢尾苷元可能作为潜在的STING抑制剂，破坏先天免疫-代谢信号，为QFXBF衍生的哮喘治疗策略提供机制支持。
